final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT p.player_id AS pid, COUNT(m.player_id) AS cnt FROM player p LEFT JOIN manager_award m ON m.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.player_id), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM s1) SELECT s1.pid, s1.cnt, CAST(s1.cnt AS REAL) / s2.total AS ratio FROM s1 JOIN s2 WHERE s2.total IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
